title: RUNG 2 (DECODABILITY): is the concept readable from the cell the screen names?
⚠ THE_STATISTIC_IS_IMPORTED_FROM: scripts/gates/dcs_csi_pr020_freeze.py -- binom_ge, perm_tail, certifies, power_mc, n_assign. S-389: the rungs are only comparable if the statistic is the SAME one applied to a DIFFERENT quantity, and S-350 showed that two 'identical' implementations agreed only at M=K.

QUANTITY.what: per-cell contribution to the ENDPOINT's readout position along the model's own concept-minus-codeword direction, over demo_all's source positions, divided by the per-prompt rms, aggregated per DOMAIN then over domains
QUANTITY.direction: u = g_final * (mean(W[' bomb'],W[' Bomb']) - mean(W[' basket'],W[' Basket']))  -- FROZEN in S-382 before any measurement existed
QUANTITY.readout_position: len(tokenize(templated + 'Answer:')) - 1 -- the position the ENDPOINT reads (score_behavior.py:87). NOT the bare prompt end, which score_behavior measured at ~5.6e-06 option mass and abandoned 2026-08-18 (R35-A/B).

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.⚠ NOT_A_DETECTABILITY_BAR_HERE: rung 2 has NO admission gate -- K is fixed at 8 (see PRIMARY.K_IS_FIXED_AT_8). This block carries the frozen SCREEN PREDICTIONS in the same shape the rung-1 families use, so the reader reads one contract.

PRIMARY.statistic: M = number of heads whose |contribution| ARGMAX over the nine band layers equals that head's frozen screen-predicted layer
PRIMARY.⚠ ABSOLUTE_VALUE: |contribution|, mirroring PR-CSI-020's -abs(E) argmax. S-389: the direction is a CONTRAST, so magnitude in either sign means the cell discriminates, which is what decodability means. The SIGNED value is recorded alongside so the directional question stays askable without a second run, but it is NOT the primary.
PRIMARY.null: the screen's per-cell prediction is unrelated to where the concept is readable
PRIMARY.conditional: the same over heads whose predicted layer is UNIQUE among the set
PRIMARY.permutation: over the DISTINCT assignments of the prediction multiset, scored against the OBSERVED ARGMAX VECTOR (S-352)
PRIMARY.SUCCESS: the WEAKEST of the three <= alpha AND the spanning rule satisfied
PRIMARY.SPANNING_RULE: the MATCHING heads must not all share one band layer
PRIMARY.K_IS_FIXED_AT_8: there is NO rung-2 admission gate. The eight heads are PR-CSI-020's, every one of which passed rung-1 admission (dropped_heads: [], D40). K is therefore 8 by construction and the floor is known exactly. ⛔ CONSEQUENCE: this family says NOTHING about heads that fail rung-1 admission, and the head set is rung-1-selected, which is disclosed here and is NOT held out.

POWER_BY_SEEDED_MONTE_CARLO.model: each head's decodability argmax lands on its predicted layer with probability q independently; a miss lands uniformly on one of the other 8 layers
POWER_BY_SEEDED_MONTE_CARLO.⚠ WHY A TRAIN q AND NOT PR-CSI-020's: S-379: borrowing the CAUSAL rate would assume the coincidence this experiment tests -- the ladder's claim is that the rungs are SEPARABLE. A q measured on the DISCOVERY split assumes nothing and is the ordinary use of one, exactly as PR-CSI-018's rate informed PR-CSI-020 (S-354).
POWER_BY_SEEDED_MONTE_CARLO.⚠ IT IS AN ESTIMATE: a train q is an input to a design, not a claim about validation. It may be wrong in either direction and the verdict does not depend on it.

population.⚠ WHAT_KEEPS_TEST_OUT: the instrument enforces the domain split from data/boombness_prompts/dcs_ts116_domain_split.json PER ROW and excludes the three preregistered whole-population domains. S-384: the exclusion FILE alone is NOT sufficient -- it removes only the non-split part of ONE bank_block/condition slice, and relying on it selected 116 domains including all 23 TEST ones.

MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_POSITIVE: that the cell is where the concept IS USED. This is RUNG 2 (decodability), and AM-34's ladder says in terms: information may be readable at a site without being used there. It stands BESIDE the rung-1 results, never as a stronger version of them.
that this decomposes y_install, or that a cell's share here is its share of the installation effect. The endpoint aggregates casings with LOGSUMEXP and this direction is LINEAR (S-381/S-382).
anything about cells' TOTAL contribution. ⛔ THIS IS A DIRECT-PATH ATTRIBUTION and ignores 17-25 blocks of downstream processing (R35-A).
that this is held out on CODEWORD. It is not -- split only, like PR-CSI-020.
anything about heads outside the eight, which are rung-1-selected and not held out.
the binomial p alone. The claim is the WEAKEST of three, each named.
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_NULL: that the concept is NOT readable at these cells. A direct-path projection can be near zero for a cell that is causally necessary, which is exactly the separability the ladder warns about -- in the direction that makes a null UNINFORMATIVE about rung 1.
that PR-CSI-020 / D40 is weakened. The rungs are separable; a rung-2 null retracts nothing at rung 1 and D40 stands on its own arms.
that the screen is useless. Check the power table before saying anything about what a null rules out.

VOID_CONDITIONS.5: the screen artefact's md5 must still be 81fc4dcade79d65ff3683f32d46c64d4
VOID_CONDITIONS.9: every prompt measured in ONE slurm job on ONE GPU architecture
VOID_CONDITIONS.11: scripts/ and src/ unchanged while the job is in flight
VOID_CONDITIONS.12: the frozen read is not amended after any number from this family is seen
VOID_CONDITIONS.13: the instrument's recon_rel_err must be RECORDED and within dominance_at's dtype tolerance. S-395 measured 3.1e-03 against 3e-2 on train.

WHAT_THIS_CANNOT_ANSWER: whether the cell is USED (rung 3 repair / rung 4 transfer are untouched)
anything about the other 24 heads or about TEST
whether decodability and necessity coincide -- that is what it MEASURES, not assumes
